slides.h:
Characteristics of Life and Classification · 1/11

What counts as alive?什么算是生命？

Living things are made of cells, use energy (metabolism), grow, reproduce, respond to stimuli and keep a steady inside (homeostasis). Over many generations, populations also evolve.生物由细胞构成，会利用能量（新陈代谢）、生长、繁殖、对刺激做出反应并保持内部稳定（稳态）；经过许多代，种群还会演化。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 2/11

Stimulus, then response先刺激，后反应

A stimulus is a change in the surroundings. A response is what the organism does about it. Sensing and reacting keeps an organism alive.刺激是环境的变化；反应是生物对它做出的行动。察觉并反应，才能活下去。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 3/11

Homeostasis in one picture一张图看懂稳态

When conditions drift, the body senses it and corrects it. Body temperature around 37 degrees C is kept steady by sweating or shivering.条件偏离时，身体察觉并纠正。约 37 摄氏度的体温靠出汗或发抖维持稳定。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 4/11

From cell to organism从细胞到个体

Cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form organ systems and systems form an organism. Each level does a bigger job.细胞组成组织，组织组成器官，器官组成系统，系统组成个体。层级越高，功能越大。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 5/11

Beyond one organism超出个体

Organisms of one species in one place form a population. Different populations form a community. Add water, soil and sunlight to get an ecosystem.同一地点同一物种的个体构成种群；不同种群构成群落；再加上水、土壤和阳光就是生态系统。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 6/11

Taxonomic ranks分类等级

From broad to narrow: Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species. Memory sentence: Dear King Philip Came Over For Good Soup.从大到小：域、界、门、纲、目、科、属、种。口诀：Dear King Philip Came Over For Good Soup。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 7/11

Two-part names双名法

Every species has a two-part scientific name: Genus species, for example Homo sapiens. The genus is capitalized, the species is lowercase, and both are italic.每个物种都有两部分的学名：属名加种加词，如 Homo sapiens。属名首字母大写，种加词小写，两者都用斜体。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 8/11

Three domains三个域

All life falls into three domains. Bacteria and Archaea are prokaryotes with no nucleus. Eukarya cells have a nucleus.所有生物分属三个域。细菌域和古菌域是没有细胞核的原核生物；真核域的细胞有细胞核。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 9/11

Using a dichotomous key使用二歧检索表

Start at step 1. Read both choices, pick the one that matches your specimen, and follow it to the next step until you reach a name.从第 1 步开始，读两个选项，选与标本相符的那个，按指示进入下一步，直到得到名称。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 10/11

Reading a cladogram读懂分支图

Each branch point is a common ancestor. Species that share a more recent common ancestor are more closely related. Read the tree by branch points, not by tip order.每个分叉点是一个共同祖先。共同祖先越近，亲缘关系越近。看分叉点，不看末端的排列顺序。

Characteristics of Life and Classification · 11/11

Derived characteristics衍生特征

A derived characteristic appears in one group and is passed to its descendants. Feathers mark the bird branch. Traits help us draw cladograms.衍生特征出现在某个类群并传给它的后代。羽毛标志鸟类这一支。性状帮助我们画分支图。

cards.f: OR·gan·ism
cards.b:
Any single living thing, such as a bacterium, a plant or a fish.

生物体：任何一个独立的生命个体，比如细菌、植物或鱼。

🧠 An organism is "organized": its parts work together as one being.organism 就是「有组织的个体」：各部分协作成一个整体。

Quick check: Is a mushroom an organism?

Yes. A fungus is a living thing.

cards.f: CELL
cards.b:
The smallest unit that can carry out all the functions of life.

细胞：能完成生命全部功能的最小单位。

🧠 Robert Hooke named cells after "cella" (small room) because they looked like tiny rooms.胡克看到的小格子像小房间（cella），所以叫 cell。

Quick check: What is the smallest unit of life?

The cell.

cards.f: ho·me·o·STA·sis
cards.b:
Keeping the inside of the body steady even when the outside changes.

稳态：外界变化时，身体内部保持相对稳定。

🧠 homeo- = similar, -stasis = standing still. A similar state kept.homeo- = 相似，-stasis = 静止：保持相近的状态。

Quick check: Why do you sweat when you are hot?

To cool down and keep a steady body temperature (homeostasis).

cards.f: me·TAB·o·lism
cards.b:
All the chemical reactions in a cell that build molecules or release energy.

新陈代谢：细胞内所有合成物质或释放能量的化学反应。

🧠 Meta = change. Food is changed into energy.meta = 改变：食物被转变成能量。

Quick check: Does a living cell use energy?

Yes. Metabolism uses and releases energy all the time.

cards.f: STIM·u·lus
cards.b:
A change in the surroundings that an organism can detect.

刺激：生物能够察觉到的环境变化。

🧠 Plural: stimuli. A stimulus "stings" you into action.复数 stimuli。stimulus 像「刺」一下让你行动。

Quick check: Name one stimulus that a plant detects.

Light (also gravity, water or touch).

cards.f: re·SPONSE
cards.b:
What an organism does after it detects a stimulus.

反应：生物察觉刺激后做出的行为或变化。

🧠 A response always follows a stimulus: stimulus first, response second.先有刺激（stimulus），后有反应（response）。

Quick check: A sunflower turns toward the sun. What is the stimulus?

Light from the sun.

cards.f: re·pro·DUC·tion
cards.b:
Making new organisms of the same kind.

繁殖：产生同类的新个体。

🧠 re- = again, produce = make. Make again.re- = 再，produce = 制造：再制造出新个体。

Quick check: Which type of reproduction needs only one parent?

Asexual reproduction.

cards.f: GROWTH and de·VEL·op·ment
cards.b:
Growing bigger and changing form as an organism moves through its life.

生长与发育：个体变大，并随生命历程改变形态。

🧠 Growth = bigger. Development = changed. A tadpole does both.生长 = 变大；发育 = 变样。蝌蚪两者都有。

Quick check: A tadpole becomes a frog. Is that growth or development?

Development (a change in form), along with growth.

cards.f: u·ni·CEL·lu·lar
cards.b:
Made of only one cell.

单细胞的：整个生物只由一个细胞构成。

🧠 uni- = one. One-cell-ular.uni- = 一：只有一个细胞。

Quick check: Is a bacterium unicellular?

Yes. It is one cell.

cards.f: mul·ti·CEL·lu·lar
cards.b:
Made of many cells that work together.

多细胞的：由许多相互协作的细胞构成。

🧠 multi- = many.multi- = 许多。

Quick check: Name a multicellular organism.

Any plant, animal or mushroom (for example, a tree).

cards.f: TIS·sue
cards.b:
A group of similar cells that do the same job.

组织：一群形态相似、执行同一功能的细胞。

🧠 A tissue is a team of the same kind of cell.组织 = 同一种细胞组成的小队。

Quick check: What do we call a group of similar cells doing one job?

A tissue.

cards.f: OR·gan
cards.b:
A body part made of several tissues that works as one unit for a job.

器官：由几种组织构成、共同完成某项任务的身体部分。

🧠 An organ is a tool made of several tissues.器官 = 由几种组织组成的「工具」。

Quick check: Is the heart a tissue or an organ?

An organ. It is made of several tissues.

cards.f: OR·gan SYS·tem
cards.b:
Several organs that work together to do a big job for the body.

器官系统：几个器官协同完成身体的某项大功能。

🧠 System = organs on one team.系统 = 同一支队伍里的几个器官。

Quick check: Name the system that includes the stomach and intestines.

The digestive system.

cards.f: LEV·els of or·gan·i·ZA·tion
cards.b:
The steps from small to large: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.

组织层次：从小到大的层级：细胞、组织、器官、器官系统、个体。

🧠 Say it in order: Cats Take Over Our Offices = cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.顺口溜：细胞→组织→器官→系统→个体。

Quick check: Which is bigger: a tissue or an organ?

An organ.

cards.f: pop·u·LA·tion
cards.b:
All the members of one species living in the same area.

种群：同一地区内同一物种的全部个体。

🧠 Population = the "people" of one species.population = 同一物种的「居民」。

Quick check: All the deer in one forest are what level?

A population.

cards.f: com·MU·ni·ty
cards.b:
All the different populations that live together in one area.

群落：同一地区内所有不同物种的种群的总和。

🧠 Community = many species living as neighbours.community = 不同物种的「邻居们」。

Quick check: Is a community made of one species or many?

Many species.

cards.f: E·co·sys·tem
cards.b:
A community plus the non-living things around it, such as water, soil and sunlight.

生态系统：群落加上周围的非生物环境，如水、土壤和阳光。

🧠 eco- = home. An ecosystem is a home with living and non-living parts.eco- = 家园；生态系统 = 有生命与无生命部分的家。

Quick check: What does an ecosystem include that a community does not?

Non-living (abiotic) factors such as water, soil and sunlight.

cards.f: tax·ON·o·my
cards.b:
The science of naming, describing and grouping living things.

分类学：为生物命名、描述并归类的科学。

🧠 taxis = arrange, nomos = law. The rules for arranging life.taxis = 排列，nomos = 规则：排列生物的规则。

Quick check: What does taxonomy do?

It names and groups living things.

cards.f: bi·NO·mi·al NO·men·cla·ture
cards.b:
A naming system where each species gets a two-part Latin name: genus then species.

双名法：每个物种用两部分拉丁名：先属名，后种加词。

🧠 bi- = two, nomen = name. Two names. Genus is Capitalized, species is lowercase.bi- = 二，nomen = 名：两个名字；属名首字母大写，种加词小写。

Quick check: Write the scientific name of humans.

Homo sapiens (genus Homo, species sapiens).

cards.f: GE·nus
cards.b:
A group of closely related species. The first part of a scientific name.

属：由亲缘关系很近的物种组成的类群，也是学名的前半部分。

🧠 Genus = "same family name": lion and tiger are both Panthera.genus 像「姓」：狮子和老虎都姓 Panthera。

Quick check: Lion is Panthera leo and tiger is Panthera tigris. What do they share?

The same genus, Panthera.

cards.f: SPE·cies
cards.b:
A group of organisms that can breed with each other and produce fertile offspring.

物种：能够相互交配并产生可育后代的一群生物。

🧠 Species is the same word for one and many: one species, two species.species 单复数同形。

Quick check: A horse and a donkey have a mule that cannot reproduce. Are they one species?

No. The offspring is not fertile, so they are separate species.

cards.f: do·MAIN
cards.b:
The broadest group in classification, above kingdom.

域：分类中最大的一级，高于界。

🧠 Domain = the biggest "territory".domain = 最大的「领地」。

Quick check: Which is bigger: domain or kingdom?

Domain.

cards.f: KING·dom
cards.b:
A large group of organisms, the rank just below domain.

界：域之下的大类群。

🧠 Kingdom = a big realm, like animals or plants.界 = 大王国，如动物界、植物界。

Quick check: Which kingdom do humans belong to?

Animalia (animals).

cards.f: PHY·lum
cards.b:
A rank below kingdom. Animals in one phylum share a basic body plan.

门：界之下的一级，同一门的动物有相似的基本身体结构。

🧠 Phylum = "tribe". Plural: phyla. Chordata = animals with a nerve cord.phylum 复数 phyla；脊索动物门 Chordata。

Quick check: What is the plural of phylum?

Phyla.

cards.f: CLASS
cards.b:
A rank below phylum. Mammals are one class.

纲：门之下的一级，例如哺乳纲。

🧠 Class sits between phylum and order.class 在门和目之间。

Quick check: Which class are humans in?

Mammalia (mammals).

cards.f: OR·der
cards.b:
A rank below class. Primates are one order.

目：纲之下的一级，例如灵长目。

🧠 Order sits between class and family.order 在纲和科之间。

Quick check: Which order includes monkeys, apes and humans?

Primates.

cards.f: FAM·i·ly
cards.b:
A rank below order, made up of related genera.

科：目之下的一级，由亲缘相近的几个属组成。

🧠 Family sits just above genus.family 紧挨在属的上面。

Quick check: Which rank is just below family?

Genus.

cards.f: bac·TE·ri·a
cards.b:
A domain of single-celled prokaryotes with no nucleus, found almost everywhere.

细菌域：单细胞原核生物组成的域，没有细胞核，几乎无处不在。

🧠 One bacterium, many bacteria.单数 bacterium，复数 bacteria。

Quick check: Do bacteria have a nucleus?

No. They are prokaryotes.

cards.f: ar·CHAE·a
cards.b:
A domain of single-celled prokaryotes that look like bacteria but are chemically different; many live in extreme places.

古菌域：外形像细菌但化学成分不同的单细胞原核生物，许多生活在极端环境中。

🧠 archae- = ancient. Archaeology = study of ancient things.archae- = 古老的。

Quick check: Name a place where archaea may live.

Hot springs, very salty lakes or deep-sea vents.

cards.f: eu·KAR·y·a
cards.b:
The domain of organisms whose cells have a nucleus: protists, fungi, plants and animals.

真核域：细胞有细胞核的生物所在的域：原生生物、真菌、植物和动物。

🧠 eu- = true, kary- = nucleus. True nucleus.eu- = 真，kary- = 核：真核。

Quick check: Are humans in Bacteria, Archaea or Eukarya?

Eukarya.

cards.f: pro·KAR·y·ote
cards.b:
A cell or organism with no nucleus. Its DNA floats free inside the cell.

原核生物：没有细胞核的细胞或生物，DNA 游离在细胞里。

🧠 pro- = before. Before the nucleus evolved.pro- = 之前：出现在细胞核之前。

Quick check: Which domains are prokaryotes?

Bacteria and Archaea.

cards.f: eu·KAR·y·ote
cards.b:
A cell or organism whose DNA is inside a nucleus.

真核生物：DNA 位于细胞核内的细胞或生物。

🧠 eu- = true. True nucleus.eu- = 真：真正的核。

Quick check: Name a eukaryote.

Any plant, animal, fungus or protist (for example, an amoeba).

cards.f: AU·to·troph
cards.b:
An organism that makes its own food, usually using light energy.

自养生物：能自己制造食物的生物，通常利用光能。

🧠 auto- = self, troph = feeding. Self-feeder.auto- = 自己，troph = 营养：自己养自己。

Quick check: Is a tree an autotroph or heterotroph?

Autotroph. It makes its own food by photosynthesis.

cards.f: HET·er·o·troph
cards.b:
An organism that cannot make its own food and eats other organisms.

异养生物：不能自己制造食物，必须以其他生物为食的生物。

🧠 hetero- = other. Fed by other things.hetero- = 其他：靠别的东西喂养。

Quick check: Are animals autotrophs or heterotrophs?

Heterotrophs.

cards.f: di·CHOT·o·mous KEY
cards.b:
A tool for identifying an organism by choosing between two descriptions at each step.

二歧检索表：通过每一步在两个描述中二选一来鉴定生物的工具。

🧠 dicho- = in two, tomos = cut. Cut in two each time.dicho- = 分成两半，tomos = 切：每一步一分为二。

Quick check: How many choices does a dichotomous key give at each step?

Two.

cards.f: phy·LOG·e·ny
cards.b:
The evolutionary history of a species or group, and how related it is to others.

系统发生：一个物种或类群的演化历史，以及它与其他类群的亲缘关系。

🧠 phylo- = tribe, -geny = origin. Family-tree origin.phylo- = 族，-geny = 起源：族谱式的起源。

Quick check: What does a phylogeny show?

How species are related through evolution.

cards.f: CLAD·o·gram
cards.b:
A branching diagram that shows how groups of organisms are related through shared traits.

分支图：用共有性状表示生物类群亲缘关系的分支图。

🧠 clado- = branch, -gram = picture. A branch picture.clado- = 分支，-gram = 图。

Quick check: On a cladogram, which two species are most closely related?

The two that share the most recent common ancestor (the nearest branch point).

cards.f: CLADE
cards.b:
A group made of one ancestor and all of its descendants.

进化枝：由一个祖先及其所有后代组成的类群。

🧠 A clade is a whole branch cut at one point: ancestor and every descendant.进化枝 = 从一个节点剪下的整根树枝：祖先加全部后代。

Quick check: Does a clade include the common ancestor and all descendants?

Yes. It includes both.

cards.f: COM·mon AN·ces·tor
cards.b:
The species that two or more groups both descended from.

共同祖先：两个或多个类群共同由其演化而来的物种。

🧠 Ancestor = the one before. Common = shared.ancestor = 在前面的那个；common = 共有。

Quick check: On a cladogram, where is the common ancestor?

At the branch point.

cards.f: de·RIVED char·ac·ter·IS·tic
cards.b:
A new trait that appears in a group and is passed on to its descendants.

衍生特征：在某个类群中新出现并传给后代的性状。

🧠 Derived = "derived from" the ancestor: a new feature added later.derived = 后来新增的特征。

Quick check: Feathers appear only in the bird branch. What do we call feathers?

A derived characteristic.

cards.f: six-KING·dom SYS·tem
cards.b:
A classification that groups life into six kingdoms: Archaea, Bacteria, Protista, Fungi, Plantae and Animalia.

六界系统：把生物分为六界：古菌界、细菌界、原生生物界、真菌界、植物界、动物界。

🧠 Six kingdoms: A B P F P A.六界首字母：A B P F P A。

Quick check: Which two kingdoms are prokaryotes?

Archaea and Bacteria.

cards.f: three-do·MAIN SYS·tem
cards.b:
A classification that places all life into three domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya.

三域系统：把所有生物分为三个域：细菌域、古菌域和真核域。

🧠 Three big boxes: B, A, E.三个大盒子：B、A、E。

Quick check: Which domain contains the kingdom Animalia?

Eukarya.

quiz.q: Which is NOT usually listed as a characteristic of life?
quiz.why: Flying is not shared by all living things. Metabolism, response and reproduction are.

quiz.q: A plant leans toward a window. The light from the window is the
quiz.why: Light is the change in the surroundings, so it is the stimulus. The leaning is the response.

quiz.q: Sweating on a hot day is an example of
quiz.why: The body is keeping its temperature steady, which is homeostasis.

quiz.q: Put these in order from smallest to largest: organ, cell, organism, tissue.
quiz.why: The levels go cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism.

quiz.q: A group of the same species living in the same area is a
quiz.why: One species in one place is a population.

quiz.q: Which level includes non-living factors such as soil and sunlight?
quiz.why: An ecosystem is the community plus its non-living environment.

quiz.q: In the name Homo sapiens, sapiens is the
quiz.why: The second part of a scientific name is the species.

quiz.q: Which is the correct way to write a scientific name?
quiz.why: Genus is capitalized, species is lowercase, and the name is italic.

quiz.q: Which taxonomic rank is the broadest?
quiz.why: Domain is above kingdom.

quiz.q: Which order is correct, broad to narrow?
quiz.why: Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species.

quiz.q: Which domain has cells WITHOUT a nucleus and often lives in extreme places?
quiz.why: Archaea are prokaryotes that often live in extreme places.

quiz.q: A mushroom absorbs food from dead matter. It is a
quiz.why: It cannot make its own food, so it is a heterotroph.

quiz.q: A dichotomous key gives how many choices at each step?
quiz.why: Dichotomous means two-way.

quiz.q: On a cladogram, a branch point represents
quiz.why: Each node is a common ancestor of the groups that branch from it.

quiz.q: A clade includes
opts: an ancestor and all its descendants
quiz.why: A clade is one ancestor plus every descendant.

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“The broadest group in classification, above kingdom.”
quiz.why: domain: The broadest group in classification, above kingdom. 域

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“The species that two or more groups both descended from.”
quiz.why: common ancestor: The species that two or more groups both descended from. 共同祖先

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A group made of one ancestor and all of its descendants.”
quiz.why: clade: A group made of one ancestor and all of its descendants. 进化枝

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A classification that places all life into three domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya.”
quiz.why: three-domain system: A classification that places all life into three domains: Bacteria, Archaea and Eukarya. 三域系统

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A rank below kingdom. Animals in one phylum share a basic body plan.”
quiz.why: phylum: A rank below kingdom. Animals in one phylum share a basic body plan. 门

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A body part made of several tissues that works as one unit for a job.”
quiz.why: organ: A body part made of several tissues that works as one unit for a job. 器官

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A rank below phylum. Mammals are one class.”
quiz.why: class: A rank below phylum. Mammals are one class. 纲

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“A new trait that appears in a group and is passed on to its descendants.”
quiz.why: derived characteristic: A new trait that appears in a group and is passed on to its descendants. 衍生特征

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“The science of naming, describing and grouping living things.”
quiz.why: taxonomy: The science of naming, describing and grouping living things. 分类学

quiz.q:
Which term matches this definition?
“All the different populations that live together in one area.”
quiz.why: community: All the different populations that live together in one area. 群落
